title: Reference Example & Production Semantic Closure Gate

packages.title: Migrate intended reference examples and close production semantic mismatches.
acceptance_criteria: Consume the complete M10.2 classification and migrate every intended reference example to the unified target grammar while preserving explicit negative/rejection and legacy-compatibility fixture classifications.

Resolve every grammar/design/example mismatch explicitly by canonical example migration, an explicit non-production disposition, or a separately versioned Python reference semantic/admission change; do not preserve ambiguous mismatches as implicit compatibility.

Align required diagnostics, semantics, and example explanations for all three reference applications and committed fixtures, with executable deterministic grammar-to-examples conformance checks that fail closed on newly inconsistent surfaces.

Where Python reference semantics or production admission must change, update and re-freeze the versioned language contract and complete the full coverage/certification gates before treating the changed surface as production-admitted.
Complete M10.3 before any M10.5 parity baseline is final; the post-M10.3 Python reference state is the only eligible source for refreshed M10.5-01 fingerprinting.
